title: Clarify button state interactions & token migration
creator: Maya Chen
description: Unify visual and motion behavior for button states across themes and migrate legacy spacing/color tokens to the new token schema. Address regressions observed after runtime-1.18 where icon-only buttons lost consistent hit areas and loading overlays occasionally blocked click-to-cancel affordances.
scope: Review and update button component variants (primary, secondary, subtle, ghost, icon-only) for: token mapping, loading overlays, disabled visuals, focus/press feedback, hit area consistency, and high-contrast theme fallbacks. Update docs and publish new token mappings for engineering migration.
goals: Establish a single token mapping table for all button states and themes
Restore consistent loading behavior that allows cancel (click) where appropriate
Ensure icon-only buttons maintain a 40x40 touch/hit target across breakpoints
Fix regressions in focus outlines and pressed motion introduced in runtime-1.18
Ship updated component docs and migration notes for frontend engineers
acceptance_criteria: All button variants match the new token values in Figma file 'Design System / Tokens / 2025-Q1'
Loading state shows skeleton spinner aligned to center, does not intercept click-to-cancel for non-blocking actions
Disabled buttons have a clear reduced-contrast token and keyboard focus is removed from disabled elements
Icon-only buttons have minimum 40x40 hit area without visual shift in layout
Regression tests added to visual diff suite (Percy) and passing on main branch
Design documentation page updated with migration table and code snippets
design_notes: Prefer opacity-based disabled treatment using token 'button.disabled-opacity' rather than color swaps to preserve color blindness contrast
Loading overlay should prefer a small spinner (size token 'spinner.small') and an optional subtle label for long ops
For icon-only buttons, always render an invisible padding element to maintain hit area; this is a CSS-only shim to avoid layout jank
Motion for press should use 'motion.press-short' token: 90ms ease-in-out; this reduced duration fixed perceived lag in user testing
High-contrast theme: fallback tokens explicitly declared (token names ending with '.hc') to avoid relying on runtime color inversion
decisions: Adopt token migration approach B (dual-read strategy) to allow scoped rollout: component reads legacy token if explicit 'legacyTokens' prop is set, otherwise uses new tokens
Make loading overlays opt-in for actions that are blocking; non-blocking operations will show an inline spinner only
Do not change markup order for icon-only buttons to prevent regressions in screen reader traversal; use CSS for hit area shims instead
